chapter: Marriage to Eve and the trio years
title: Bill Dillard's death; the trio ends
summary: Dillard died in a fire saving another man, after which Gene Wright and Norvo couldn't continue; Jimmy Wyble helped him through a club date.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: And then we came back and Bill Dillard and

Gene and I worked together in Santa Monica during the summer and Bill was killed in a fire, saving another fella. He -- got his head out the window and saved the fella who was sleeping on his couch, but in doing so, he breathed so much smoke that he just lay down on the bed and it poisoned him, the smoke. And the other fella was saved, but they called me in six in the morning and so after that Gene Wright and I couldn't work together

I said, 'Gene, we'll never make it.' He said, 'I know.' So he came to Chicago, or he went to Chicago and then he went back and Brubeck Brubaker, I think at that time, I think it was either Brubeck or Cal Tjader first, and then Brubeck --

But we never worked together after that. We were good friends, and then I -- I -- the guy that we were working for in Santa Monica said, 'I'm not going to get anybody else,' so I said, 'I really don't want to work.' He said, 'Well, I'm not going to get anybody else. When you feel like coming back.' So (unintelligible) called me who's a friend of his and said, 'I'm sorry to hear about Bill,' so I said, 'What're you doing?' I said, 'Let's go over to a place and play some tunes for this guy tonight. I mean he's been very nice to me, I feel a little -- I feel bad, but I feel worse if I -- not at least trying to help him. He's got a club in the -- so Gene had already left and we picked up another bass player, in San Francisco, who was down, and went over and played awhile. And he was
a little scared, he didn't really want to do it, he'd never played in a trio .
